name: Site Diagnosis & Clarification Regression Set
description: Tests incomplete site scenarios to ensure clarification questions are asked rather than ungrounded diagnosis.

parts.text: Biodiversity is declining on my land.

To provide an evidence-grounded diagnosis, please clarify key site parameters: 1) What specific species or indicators are declining? 2) What is the historical land use and crop rotation? 3) What are the local soil and climatic conditions?
